name: MKT-14-NY-T31s+NOSL+XNFP+VOV
logic: As nomem6_005 plus vol-of-vol filter: std(ATR14,48)/mean(ATR14,48) < 0.35 at entry.

name: MKT-14-NY-T31s+NOSL+XNFP+SSR
logic: As nomem6_005 (Friday 14:00 short, day up >0.5*ATR14, skip first Friday, no stop, exit 21:00) plus Nasif minSSR>-2: for 18 slope slots (H1/H4/D1 x SMA2/5/10 x shift0/1, slope=(SMA-SMA.shift(scale))/point) require min over k in {1,6,8,10,12,14,16} of slp0/slp[k] > -2.

name: MKT-14-NY-T31s+NOSL+XNFP+LOSSYOVB
logic: As nomem6_005 plus Nasif lossy-overbought divergence state at the 14:00 bar: Stoch(14,3) on H1 > 80 AND (min slope of SMA2/5/10 on 24-bar scale (slope=(SMA(pd*24)-SMA(pd*24).shift(24))/point) < 0 OR its accel < 0) AND at least one of the 18 slope slots negative.

name: MKT-13-16-NY-T86s+LOSSY+Z09+FRI+TRAIL08
logic: Same entry as nomem6_016 (Friday 13:00-16:00 UTC SHORT first hit, lossy-overbought divergence AND z-score >= 0.9).
